scope: Replay all 48 CG-003 initial decisions and all 32 supported-route trajectories across CG-003 and DG-013. Fixed first-dev-world panel; overlapping inputs are not independent examples.
questions: Does the model reject role-swapped facts despite both independent presence factors being true?
Where does pointer probability go during actual value emission, and does it transport complete ordered values?
method: Frozen checkpoint and exact saved C inputs/actual prefixes. Run neural forward without metadata. Afterwards annotate byte-aligned source fact/value spans. Preserve NULL, structural tokens and ambiguous boundaries separately. Record raw position and duplicate-token aggregated contribution; attention is attribution, not proof of semantic binding. No forced gold route/span or alternative generation.
limits: No training, new seeds, LoCoMo, oracle decoding, source text in reply prompt or serving change. Exact value byte inclusion is a diagnostic, not semantic accuracy. Decoder base can complete correct or incorrect names independently of memory.
